prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic romantic cottagecore portrait of an approved adult woman in a rustic ivy-covered archway.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with fair skin and long straight platinum-blonde hair, center-parted and tied with a large white bow. She wears a white halter-neck mini dress with a corset-style bodice, vertical boning, structural seams, and a flared pleated skirt, with white pointed-toe heels and simple pearl earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 full-body portrait, subject standing in the arched doorway with one hand resting high on the doorframe, body angled slightly, head turned away, and legs crossed at the ankles. Frame her with rough cream stone, white wood, climbing ivy, a warm beige interior, and black-and-white geometric floor tiles; keep the doorway as a natural frame.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural daylight with gentle shadows and a summery afternoon atmosphere. Use natural color grading and controlled highlights across the white dress, hair, stone, and ivy.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait, 3:4 vertical crop, eye-level perspective, sharp subject detail, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric and stone textures, subtle natural grain, restrained dynamic range.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4K photorealistic portrait of an approved adult woman with fair skin and long platinum-blonde hair tied with a large white bow, standing in a rustic arched doorway.
